data.short_meaning: A combination of Raphael and Linda, meaning 'God heals' and 'Light', respectively
data.long_meaning: Rafalina is a beautiful, unique name for a girl, inspired by the biblical name Raphael, meaning 'God heals'. The second part of the name, Linda, means 'Light'. Together, Rafalina represents the divine power of healing and the brightness of the light of God. The name Rafalina carries the meaning “A combination of Raphael and Linda, meaning 'God heals' and 'Light', respectively” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Rafalina usually hope their child will grow to embody a combination of raphael and linda, meaning 'god heals' and 'light', respectively and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Ραφαλίνα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ραφαλίνα είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Θεία θεραπεία' ή 'Θεός ιατρός'. Το όνομα αυτό αποτελείται από δύο λέξεις: 'Ραφαήλ' που σημαίνει 'Θεός θεραπεύει' και τη κατάληξη '-ίνα' που δηλώνει μικρότητα ή γεια. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ραφαλίνα χρησιμοποείται ως υπενθύμιση για την θεραπεία και τη φροντίδα του Θεού.

She is believed to have been a young woman who was tortured and killed for refusing to renounce her faith. According to legend, she was tortured with a millstone which was rolled over her body, but she remained unharmed and her faith unshaken. She is venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church and her feast day is celebrated on May 26.

Saint Rafalina of Foligno, also known as Santa Raffaella or Raffaella of Foligno, was a Christian mystic and stigmatized nun from Italy who lived during the Late Middle Ages. She is believed to have experienced mystical visions and stigmata, the wounds of Christ, from the age of twenty-one until her death. She is venerated as a saint in the Catholic Church and her feast day is celebrated on January 24.
